name: cooViewer
vendor: coo (original author); maintained fork by ysmx on GitHub
current_version: 1.7.1 (ysmx fork); original coo-ona build stopped at 1.2b25 (2020)
summary: Long-standing Japanese manga and comic viewer for the Mac, now kept alive as an actively updated open-source fork with a universal binary. Opens folders, PDFs and almost any archive (ZIP, RAR, 7z, LHA, split archives, password-protected ones) as a book, with right-to-left spreads, page bookmarks, freely assignable keys and mouse actions, and Finder thumbnails for comic archives.
where_it_wins: Dedicated manga reader: right-to-left two-page spreads with automatic single-page detection, saved per book
Named page bookmarks and remembered last page per book
Every key and mouse action assignable, one-handed defaults
Opens a huge range of archive formats, including split RAR/ZIP and password-protected archives
Finder thumbnails and Quick Look for CBZ/CBR/ZIP/RAR/7z
where_schnellbild_wins: Videos (MP4, MKV, WebM …), including straight from archives
Browses folders and archives as folders with a thumbnail grid and folder previews
File management: rename, move, copy, two panes, undo
App Sandbox, notarized, in many languages (cooViewer: English and Japanese)
Mixed photo and video slideshow through all subfolders

native_apple_silicon.note: Universal binary (arm64 + x86_64) since the fork's Sequoia update

no_account_no_tracking.note: No account, ads or network code; local viewer

dark_light_setting.note: Own colour settings for background, page number and page bar; no separate light/dark app theme switch found

folder_browsing.note: Opens a folder or archive directly as a book; next/previous folder and 'Open in Same Folder'; no file browser

thumbnail_grid.note: Thumbnail grid of the pages of the open book (can open archives from it since 1.4.2); no folder-preview browser

list_view.note: No list or column view in the interface

recursive_search.note: No file name search in menus or panels (opens Finder saved searches as a book)

network_shares_fast.note: 1.4.2 made loading lazy for folders with many subfolders/archives; network shares not mentioned

multiple_windows.note: Menus show a single viewer window and no 'New Window'; not stated explicitly. Searched manual, menu strings, changelog

bookmarks.note: Named page bookmarks per book and Recent Books; no folder favourites

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC/HEIF, WebP, AVIF declared; JPEG XL not listed

img_raw.note: DNG, CR2/CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, RW2, ORF, PEF and more via macOS

img_svg_pdf.note: PDF yes (pages as a book); SVG not listed
